title: Execution semantics
description: How a capability treats execution IDs and work in progress, declared by the provider in its manifest and shown to consumers before they connect.

execution_id_retention_days.description: How long the provider keeps each execution ID with its input fingerprint and result, so a repeat returns the stored result instead of running again. The reference adapter keeps 7 days.

cancellable.description: Whether peer_cancel can stop an execution in progress.

in_flight_on_revocation.description: What happens to admitted work in progress when the connection ends or is blocked: completed, or cancelled where possible.

repeat.description: Adapter profile: what a repeated execution ID returns.

completion.description: Adapter profile: reliable (durable mode) or best-effort (storage-free) completion.
